audit.scope: Personal rent and homeowner property-tax dependencies in declared model sources for 50 states and DC. The inventory includes direct credits, deductions, subtractions, itemization and federal taxable-income inheritance. It excludes business and landlord expenses and property-sale gains.
audit.interpretation: Source declarations identify model dependencies. They do not establish legal entitlement, a household result or a zero benefit when the inspected sources contain no route. Method dates and parameter dates describe the frozen source; later branches do not establish a 2025 route. Declared government references remain separate from legal validation.
